phase3b.note: every adapter that declares output_sorted or has a documented post-sort, oracle with --check-sorted, expected ranking from approaches/W4/REPORT.md section 6 The --check-sorted oracle runs over the full battery (ties, signed zeros, floods), not only random: verify-W4 showed W2_packed fp32 (N4 truncation leaves equal-under-truncation keys in index order) and W5_v4 (tie_heavy, quantized_random) are not sorted although their reports say so.
